DeployBot: Pipeline triggered for release candidate - env: staging - commit: 8f3b2a1 - tag: rc/0.9.12-2026-03-19 - stages: build | unit-test | lint | smoke

sam.dev: grabbing logs and watching the run

DeployBot: Build: SUCCESS — artifact: redwood-inference-server:8f3b2a1

DeployBot: Unit tests: FAILED (12 failed of 432) — failing suite: runtime/caching_tests

jordan.runtime: looking into failing tests, collecting failing traces now

jordan.runtime: snippet from failing test log:
```
E   AssertionError: prefix_cache miss expected 1 got 0
  File "tests/runtime/test_cache.py", line 87, in test_prefix_cache
    assert cache.hits == 1
```

rita.qa: I can re-run the unit job but lint is next — might be unrelated

DeployBot: Unit tests rerun queued by @jordan.runtime

amy.release: Heads up — lint stage often flakes since we upgraded `ruff` last week. If lint fails we should consider pinning ruff to 0.1.37 for this RC to avoid blocking the change window

sam.dev: Agree. Change window closes at 17:00 PST. If unit failures are legit, we may need rollback; if it's lint-only we can pin and rerun quickly.

DeployBot: Unit tests: RETRY -> SUCCESS (all tests green)

DeployBot: Lint: FAILED — 1 error in infra/serve.py -> import-order (ruff: E401)

amy.release: Confirmed, appears to be ruff import-order rule being stricter than before. Quick options: 1) pin ruff to previous patch and rerun CI 2) quick fix PR to adjust ordering 3) mark lint as non-blocking for RC (we should avoid)

lee.pm: Decision needed — what do we recommend? We have client demos tomorrow and prefer to keep the RC. Change window still open for 45m.

jordan.runtime: I pushed a two-line fix in a WIP branch that normalizes imports to appease ruff -> PR #4821, ready for merge if we pin or bump CI image

sam.dev: If #4821 is small, merging is fastest. Pinning ruff might be quicker actually since CI caches will let lint pass instantly. I'd vote pin+rerun.

rita.qa: Pin + rerun is lowest risk. I can kick the lint rerun once CI config is updated.

amy.release: I'll open a config PR to pin ruff to 0.1.37 in the pipeline (infra/ci-config) and request a fast-track review.

DeployBot: CI config PR created -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1284 (label: fast-track)

sam.dev: Reviewing now, will approve in 2 mins

amy.release: Approved and merged. Triggering pipeline rerun.

DeployBot: Lint: SUCCESS on rerun — all checks passed. Full pipeline: PASSED.

lee.pm: OK — promoting RC to canary in staging window. Good job folks :thumbsup: :rocket:

sam.dev: noted — will watch canary telemetry for 30m, if anything noisy we have rollback playbook ready.

rita.qa: smoke tests scheduled, I'll post results

DeployBot: Canary promotion complete — canary tag: canary/0.9.12-2026-03-19 - deployed to staging-canary-2

rita.qa: Smoke: PASS (quick checks green)

sam.dev: all clear so far. Closing thread unless issues surface.
